insights.articleTitle: Badenoch + Clark and Spring Professional are now LHH
insights.introParagraph: The LHH brand, a subsidiary of The Adecco Group and sister company of the Badenoch + Clark and Spring Professional brands, is strengthening its international presence and its service offering for companies, by integrating a global approach to recruitment and talent management.
insights.postedDateAndAuthor: Posted on February 5, 2023 - 5:30 AM by Author
